soft_deny: Bash(terraform apply:*) in infrastructure/aws-*/ — protected IaC scope (Terraform state/backends for ALB, assets bucket, database, deployment-state bucket, ECR, ECS async worker)
Bash(aws secretsmanager delete-secret:*) — secrets-store destructive action against AWS Secrets Manager
